title: Kernel tries dropshipping
caption: Ep 1: Kernel tries dropshipping 📦😭 Which side hustle should Kernel try next? 👇 #comedy #sidehustle #animation #fyp

scenes.say: Kernel's side hustle saga. Episode one: dropshipping.
A guy on TikTok said dropshipping makes ten thousand dollars a week. I'm going to be rich by Friday!
Okay, I spent all my money on ads for glow in the dark socks. Now we wait.
One order! Oh wait. It's my mom. She wants a refund.
I'm not rich. But I do own four hundred pairs of glow in the dark socks.
Comment Kernel's next side hustle, and follow for episode two.
